cloudless-day.hdr.title: SILENCE cloudless daylight radiance
cloudless-day.hdr.author: Original generated game asset
cloudless-day.hdr.type: 1024 × 512 Radiance RGBE high dynamic range equirectangular environment
cloudless-day.hdr.method: Analytic Rayleigh-style zenith/horizon radiance, without clouds or a baked sun. The solar disc and twilight are animated in the sky shader.

starfield-night.hdr.title: SILENCE night-sky radiance
starfield-night.hdr.author: Original generated game asset
starfield-night.hdr.type: 2048 × 1024 Radiance RGBE high dynamic range equirectangular environment
starfield-night.hdr.method: Original diffuse galactic haze and starlight radiance. The low-resolution raster stars have been replaced by 4200 deterministic spherical points resolved at framebuffer resolution in game/sky.ts, with varied apparent magnitude and subtle color temperature. Sidereal rotation follows the celestial pole. Artistic distribution, not an astronomical catalogue.

daytime-visible-palette.source: Archived native 1774 × 887 reference; image variant removed from the game
daytime-visible-palette.sampling: Median RGB of all 1774 pixels in each listed row, ordered horizon to zenith
daytime-visible-palette.rendering: The original daylight HDRI still supplies PBR illumination. The background uses these exact palette samples with inverse ACES exposure compensation and sky-only grading bypass; atmospheric fog and twilight still affect apparent colors.

procedural-clouds.method: Original deterministic tiled multi-scale noise, advected in world space at 900 m. Shared cloud optical density occludes sun, moon, galactic haze and stellar points. No photographic clouds or AI sky variants are loaded.
